python_package.name: laya
python_package.integrity: informational: pip resolves the pinned version from PyPI without hash mode (locking the full torch graph is out of scope). The daemon enforces the installed version at startup and reports version_mismatch. The interpreter defaults to "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/pi-laya/venv/bin/python" and can be overridden with the portable-config `python` key.

model.revision_integrity: enforced: the daemon downloads exactly this revision through huggingface_hub snapshot_download(revision=...) and loads the local snapshot path
model.sha256_integrity: enforced: the daemon hashes each checkpoint's model.safetensors against the digest below before loading and refuses to serve on mismatch

notes: English checkpoint is the `typed-decisions/` subfolder: best English accuracy in the synthetic evaluation (12/16 vs 11/16 for the base root checkpoint and 10/16 for the multilingual one) at equal decision latency. The multilingual/ subfolder is the Italian-capable checkpoint.
Checkpoint choice was evaluated against scripts/laya-routing-fixture.json by scripts/laya-routing-eval.py; docs/extensions.md records the full results and the observed zero-shot weaknesses.
Laya is an optional runtime dependency: without it, or with a version that does not match the pin, the daemon reports degraded and the extension fails open.
Model weights live in the huggingface_hub cache (or the pinned snapshot it manages) and are never copied into this repository.
Values were recorded from the PyPI 0.3.20 release and the HF API revision endpoint; update them deliberately with the model, not by floating to main.
